@echo off
setlocal
title DeepSeek Harness Web

set "PORT=__PORT__"
set "URL=__URL__"

rem Check that the dsh CLI is available
where dsh >nul 2>&1
if errorlevel 1 (
    echo [ERROR] dsh not found. Install it first: npm install -g @deepseek-ai/dsh
    pause
    exit /b 1
)

rem If the server is already running, just open the browser
netstat -ano | findstr /c:":%PORT%" | findstr /c:"LISTENING" >nul 2>&1
if not errorlevel 1 (
    echo [DSH] Server already running, opening browser...
    start "" "%URL%"
    exit /b 0
)

echo [DSH] Starting DeepSeek Harness Web on port %PORT% ...
echo [DSH] Keep this window open. Closing it stops the server.

rem Start the server in the background of this console
start "" /b dsh web --port %PORT%

rem Poll until the port is ready (max ~60s), then open the browser
set "tries=0"
:waitloop
set /a tries+=1
if %tries% gtr 60 (
    echo [ERROR] Timed out waiting for the server.
    echo [HINT] Run manually: dsh web --port %PORT%
    pause
    exit /b 1
)
ping -n 2 127.0.0.1 >nul
netstat -ano | findstr /c:":%PORT%" | findstr /c:"LISTENING" >nul 2>&1
if not errorlevel 1 (
    echo [DSH] Server ready, opening browser...
    start "" "%URL%"
    goto done
)
goto waitloop

:done
echo [DSH] Server running. Close this window to stop it.
pause
